protocol.task: H05K7/20 electronics thermal conditioning, CPC or IPC and descendants
protocol.interpretation: Cooling, ventilating or heating arrangements for electric apparatus; coded association, not applicability
protocol.identity: As-published upper-alphanumeric owner names; full owner sets
protocol.candidate_source: Frozen current-grant v1 broad thermal candidate universe; remove any battery coded candidate and union of previously evaluated battery shortlist grant IDs
protocol.prior_list_exclusion: All selected_primary_*.parquet in primary_v1 and text_distance_v1; decision_selected*.parquet, taskpool_raw_selected*.parquet, taskpool_disambig_selected*.parquet and fine_core_slot_selected.parquet in revision_v2. Union across years, policies, boundaries and models before outcomes
protocol.core_definition: CPC/IPC H05K7/20-prefix and no CPC/IPC battery H01M10/(6[0-9]|50)-prefix
protocol.task_profile: Focal prior-five-year pure electronics core title centroid
protocol.vocabulary: Original mature-origin TFIDF title fit, 2010 to t-3; max20000 min_df2 max_df.98 unigram/bigram English-stopwords sublinear float32
protocol.novelty: At least one unordered four-character CPC/IPC subclass pair absent from focal pure-core five-year history
protocol.feasibility: Require >=9 core and >=21 noncore pool patents; pair policy also >=3 newpair core. Report failures, do not change capacity/definition
protocol.selection: Original score descending and stable patent-ID ties; pair3 reserves 3 novel core then fills remaining6 core by score; same21 noncore across fixed policies
protocol.primary_outcome: At least one external pure-electronics-core citing grant, t+1 through t+3
protocol.filters: Known citing owner, full citing/cited owner-set nonoverlap, different known application; utility nonwithdrawn grant; no battery-coded electronics citing core
protocol.inference: Paired organization bootstrap2000, seed20261001, retain all sampled organization origins, denominator sampled situation count
protocol.transport_boundary: Task not used for original policy design; shared 2018-21 period and broad thermal corpus, predictors may train on electronics. Not prospective or unseen prediction domain
